purpose: Make repository knowledge deterministically discoverable for fresh ChatGPT sessions with limited context.

pre_overhaul_backup_gate.preferred_backup_method: mirror-style repository copy preserving Git history, branches and tags where technically practical
pre_overhaul_backup_gate.recovery_purpose: Preserve the complete pre-overhaul repository and information architecture as an independent recovery reference.

validator_checks: standalone pre-overhaul backup repository exists and is verified
pre-overhaul backup manifest records source and backup provenance
frozen source checkpoint predates first structural overhaul change
ACTIVE_BUILD candidate state AUTO_BUILD_RESULT and BuildSpecs lifecycle are consistent
BuildSpecs base profile and SHA guard are correct
build lineage and supersession targets resolve
live roadmap does not point at superseded build as current
answerability_examples: Was ist der aktuelle akzeptierte Build?
Wie hoch ist das Thumper Bite Limit?
Warum ist Shatteredrooms auf Experimentation/Embrion eingeschraenkt?
Wie importiere ich einen neuen Gale-Build?
Wo ist das Repository von vor dem Overhaul gesichert?
binary_and_large_file_policy: important future reasoning must not depend only on opaque binary content
every active/accepted r2z must have ProfileSources snapshot and FILE_INDEX
important DLLs require source/readme/build record and SHA256
large logs require indexed RuntimeEvidence summaries while preserving raw evidence
overhaul_complete_when: A verified independent pre-overhaul repository backup exists, then a fresh ChatGPT session can answer ordinary project questions from a compact bootstrap plus on-demand topic/evidence files, without reading the entire repository or reconciling unclassified historical current wording.
